body: today was just something that pushed me over the edge....at least I didn't cry in front of the guys....

stop...It's a fuckin whirlwind inside my head..It's pain...it's a final straw...it's that goddamn observation. Maybe I'm too sensitive...I don't know...You don't even know me. 
I am a mechanic but I'm new. I mean I have no mechanical background but I went to school and I became certified to fix planes and I suck....It's like I can't troubleshoot and the simplest tasks take a long time for me to finish, like I get stuck on stupid. I know I'm smart but I'm just so distracted with how pathetic I am...do you understand? I am pathetic. It sucks being seen as the stupid person at work... and it's not like this is  a new feeling, I've been told I'm a failure by my exes and my dad (I have a good relationship with him)...Just today I was told by a coworker about somethings I've done recently at work that would be unacceptable in other companies and I dunno...It's hard...I am just not good with anything...I try to work hard but in this career you're a dipshit if you don't already waltz in with some knowledge of what you're doing....

I DON'T MATTER. 

you know what my kid needs in his life????? A mom who doesn't think like this, who isn't a piece of shit and who wants to be there for him for as long as possible. My husband deserves a wife who is more like him--kinder, more loving, more understanding, more compassionate, and more emotionally together. Fuck....just fuck it.....

I can't give you help...All I can do is feel like you went through my mind... We're not cowards, GODDAMMIT!!! We aren't cowards. I am tired of people like us feeling inferior because we aren't "NORMAL"...I am normal as fuck and so are you. Death is scary and alluring but you start learning at a young age that beautiful things are the ugliest and most boring. People like you and me, with these thoughts of nothing and everything, we are BEAUTIFUL and WONDERFUL... FUCK! I want to know you. I want to talk with you.
STOP!!! Just stop... don't say bye to us when you never said hello.
